dispositions.completeSelectedProcedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, one target's movement controlled for two rounds and STR resistance. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect. No shared language, hearing, particular limb count or humanoid anatomy is required; actual locomotion still needs its own real anatomy and permissions. The target makes initial STR. Success establishes nothing. Failure establishes a movement-only compulsion, nonconcentration, through its second future original regular-turn END, excluding an already-underway turn. Outside initiative its original maximum is twelve elapsed seconds. It may repeat STR at the first affected future regular END before that maximum; success ends this application. Expiry wins at the second END, so no useless final save or extra turn is generated.

NEW at each of the target's next two future regular STARTs after normal start processing, a conscious capable caster who currently perceives the target within 60 feet and line of effect may issue one exact finite route through terrain the caster actually knows. It costs no extra Action/Bonus Action, but is only an instruction opportunity, not a fresh movement budget. The route uses the target's real available movement modes and ordinary movement allowance on that turn. Execute as much legal route as possible before contradictory voluntary movement, competing through ordinary Compelled Budget Arbitration with the timestamp of this particular route's issue. The target/controller supplies safe legal details not fixed by the route. No valid current order means ordinary movement agency for that opportunity; old orders do not automatically repeat, and recovering consciousness later in a turn creates no missed START opportunity. For an independent-turn creature outside initiative, NEW explicitly bind these route opportunities to the reviewed shared six-second control cycle. With no existing cycle, the first START is immediately after successful resolution, its END at +6 seconds, and the second START follows that END. With an existing cycle, never replay its already-passed START or refill its movement; only the next two future STARTs before the original twelve-second maximum can supply orders. The first END belonging to an actually affected future opportunity supplies the early STR save. On entering initiative, carry the existing opportunity and spent budget under the reviewed mapping; ordinary real-start events still occur but no control START or movement refills twice.

The caster controls the instructed ordinary path, including legal walking, swimming, climbing, flying, crawling or standing when the existing movement rules permit them. It cannot grant a missing movement mode, activate a finite flight ability, force Dash/Disengage, take an Action, spend RP, compel teleportation or commandeer an attack. Ordinary movement costs, actual remaining Speed, difficult terrain, occupied spaces, anchors and grapple limits apply. Speed zero can leave no executable travel. A blocked segment permits only actual safe progress along the same instruction; no substitute destination, accumulated displacement or extra off-turn movement is banked. No knowingly self-destructive route, unsupported suicidal step, known serious hazard, protected secret or prohibited resource expenditure can be forced. Ordinary opportunity attacks remain possible. This is compelled use of movement and cannot invoke the no-opportunity-attack rule for pushes/pulls.

Movement acquired by a voluntarily chosen Dash or other genuine later permission stays real but cannot be spent contrary to the current route while its movement instruction remains operative; the spell cannot compel the Action or resource needed to obtain that extra allowance. An independently legal teleport is not ordinary movement expenditure and is not controlled by this source. At turn end the issued route expires. Losing the caster's observation after a valid route was issued does not rewrite it or create remote information; the next route still needs fresh actual eligibility. This profile is not whole-Action denial, Speed reduction, Root or Restrained, so it claims no hard-control allowance merely for controlling movement.

For an owner-attached companion, NEW substitute its next two original-owner regular attached phases for the two START opportunities and those phase endings for the finite two-round marker/save bridge. It receives only the movement its actual chassis already allows, not an independent turn, owner Bonus Action charge, new command/offensive allowance or extra phase. The absolute twelve-second outside-initiative maximum persists; absent original phases cannot be invented. A genuinely established later Puppet Strings from the same caster replaces that caster's older application on the same target; other casters retain independent orders but share the same actual movement budget. Suppression at an order opportunity loses that opportunity; suppression during execution releases only the then-current compulsion while spent movement remains spent. A still-live issued route may resume within its same actual turn if suppression ends, but no already-passed opportunity replays. Removal, target death or expiry ends the application; caster incapacity prevents further orders without itself creating a concentration loss. The strings are an incorporeal control description, not cuttable rope or a machine with HP.

CTRL15-PUPPET-END-01 — scoped authored completion for Puppet Strings only. Record the two original future movement opportunities and the first one's ending-save checkpoint independently of whether a route will be issued or executed. An already-underway turn or attached phase when the effect establishes is neither future opportunity and grants no retrospective route or early save. At the first recorded eligible future regular END, or the END of the first actual future original-owner attached phase for an attached companion, offer this application's one early STR ending save if it still exists and the original expiry has not occurred. This END save requires neither a successful START instruction nor actual travel. Suppression at that START, no conscious/perceiving caster, Grappled/Speed zero, an unavailable route or a lost movement budget cannot postpone the checkpoint to a later opportunity or remove the save. The existing scheduled-save-during-suppression rule also applies when suppression continues across this END. A successful save ends this application; failure leaves only its original remaining opportunity and original deadline. At the second original END, expiry occurs first and no redundant final save is rolled. Missing real companion phases create no extra phase, order, movement, ordinary START/END trigger or resource refresh; no END-only substitute for an absent attached phase is granted by this Puppet-only completion. Preserve the original maximum/expiry marker under the existing timing contract. In EN6-03-B, release at 2.2 excludes the underway phase ending 2.4; suppression over START 8 loses that route, but END 8.4 still offers the original early STR save, and expiry stays 14.4.

dispositions.name: Willbreaker
dispositions.reason: Select the disclosed60-second concentration/initial WIS/regular-END completion. Prohibit new spell commitments and deliberate magic-item function, not all magical class actions, passive equipment, existing concentration or previously committed casts. Ordinary Ready release is not a second casting. Unknown magic-tool use can lose only the genuine ordinary task attempt without charge or a diagnostic; it does not compress the tool's separate activation. Quicken and an already-committed interrupt-stack example retain actual provider/timing prerequisites.
dispositions.completeSelectedProcedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, one target unable to cast spells or use magic items and WIS ending saves. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect. It makes initial WIS; success establishes nothing. Failure imposes the following source-owned restriction, concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds, with WIS repeated at each regular target END including an affected current turn's upcoming END. Outside initiative use the explicit END-only cadence. This supplies a finite ongoing duration in place of Core's preserved Instantaneous placeholder. No Charmed, Frightened, Incapacitated, Unconscious or generic mental damage is applied.

NEW spell restriction: the recipient cannot begin a new actual spellcasting commitment through any class, innate casting, item or other genuine spell source, regardless of RP price or omitted components. A paid zero-RP cantrip is still a spell. A nonspell class ability does not become one merely because it costs RP, is magical, or resembles a spell; use the actual source classification. An ongoing minute-long cast cannot perform future required spellcasting work while restricted, and ends/fails only under its own genuine interruption/work rule with already-paid costs retained. An instantaneous cast or Reaction already legally committed before this restriction established resolves through its existing stack; the restriction is not a retroactive Counterspell. A fully cast readied spell's later release is not another casting commitment and may still occur if its real concentration, release trigger and other permissions survive. Quicken's two separately paid child casts are each new commitments, so a not-yet-committed child is prohibited even if its parent was already cast.

NEW magic-item use means deliberate functional use, not every benefit from being near a magical object. The creature cannot intentionally activate, invoke or expend a magic item's properties, drink/use a magical consumable, command an item through its item-use interface, or wield a genuinely magical weapon/tool as the implement of an attack or task. A magic sword therefore cannot be swung as a weapon while this restriction operates; the creature may use an independently legal mundane weapon or unarmed profile instead. Wearing previously equipped passive magical armor, retaining a passive numeric item bonus, or benefiting from an independently running item effect is not automatically suppressed. An already active magic weapon does not turn mundane, and no property is erased globally. The recipient may safely carry, put down, give physical custody of, or remove an item through ordinary permissions; those handling acts cannot be disguised activations. Equipping an item specifically to invoke a new magical function remains prohibited; merely removing dangerous gear is not blocked.

Apply real present magical-item classification from the item's own profile/actual enchantment. An unrelated spell buff on a person does not make every held object a magic item. A remote non-item companion command remains a separate class/creature interface unless its actual source requires prohibited item use. A device that genuinely is a magic item is not exempt because it has wheels or another operator. Static attributes, already running allied buffs, the target's concentration and independently acting companions continue under their own dependencies. This is user-action restriction, not an antimagic area, dispel, broken item, drained charge or loss of spell knowledge. A source requiring future actual prohibited casting/item use fails at that future requirement; an effect requiring only ordinary concentration does not.

Known prohibited choices cannot be committed and spend no new spell RP or item charges. If a purportedly ordinary action is genuinely attempted on an item whose magical status is hidden, its ordinary committed action/work is spent before the functional use fails; no prohibited charge is spent and no special item-identification readout is supplied. Mere repeated declaration with no actual commitment is not an identification oracle. This proposal restricts specific action types while leaving other real Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and movement available, so it does not claim the whole-Action hard-control allowance. Actual defenses expressly covering these restrictions still apply. Independent Willbreaker instances keep their own casters, concentration, saves and deadlines; their prohibition does not stack in magnitude. Successful source removal/save, expiry, target death or concentration loss ends that instance. Suppression temporarily lifts it without restoring spent costs, old concentration, item charges or time; a later resumption bars only future prohibited commitments.

dispositions.name: Mental Prison
dispositions.reason: Select the full INT-admitted sixty-second concentration subjective prison with actual-body-expanded bounds, permitted interior Actions and voluntary departure restriction. CTRL15-PRISON-ROOT-01 keeps one admission-created original-caster Null snapshot across separate entry/exit5d10 events, consumes exit before callbacks, and distinguishes source-disabling suppression, real death, same-caster commitment displacement and different-caster replacement admission. True Seeing's exact independently accepted mental-departure bridge uses the live exit entitlement; it is not dispel. This full conference now selects Mental Prison's authored procedure; the project index and older historical receipt labels are not rewritten.
dispositions.completeSelectedProcedure:
KEEP both Enchantment and Illusion placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, one target trapped in an illusory reality and 5d10 psychic when entering or leaving. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect and make an initial INT save. Success establishes no prison and deals no damage. On failure, if a genuine mental/illusion defense does not prevent entry, establish one subjective prison around that target. The fixed real boundary is the target's current axis-aligned occupied-body bounding box expanded five feet in each direction; it is not a physical wall, object, dimensional pocket or plane. Record the actual shape/anchor before damage. The caster's concentration maintains it for at most sixty elapsed seconds, an explicitly NEW duration replacing the preserved Instantaneous placeholder.

NEW entering is actual first establishment of this illusory state, not later movement into its former footprint by anyone else. On that one entry, deal 5d10 psychic to the recipient as an ordinary defended packet, with no second damage save. Its psychic immunity can prevent damage without preventing the separately admitted illusion. Charmed-only/Frightened-only immunity is not automatically illusion immunity. A defense that truly prevents the mental illusion prevents entry and its entry-triggered damage. Actual target death from entry ends the application with no postmortem exit packet.

Within the prison the target perceives its real interior occupants and objects, but a convincing opaque enclosure replaces its visual/auditory perception of the exterior. The invented enclosure grants no real cover, collision, sound barrier or support to anyone. Genuine unaffected nonvisual senses retain their real scope. The target cannot willingly move, self-teleport or accept transport across the fixed boundary while that belief/control component remains operative. It can move legally inside, speak, take other permitted Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions, maintain concentration, and interact with actual interior targets. No Charmed, Frightened, Restrained, Speed zero or Incapacitated is added. Perception-dependent attacks/spells need actual available perception; attacks through the nonexistent physical wall otherwise obey their real unseen-target/line rules. Because ordinary Actions remain available and only a voluntary boundary/perception restriction is imposed, this proposed profile spends no whole-Action denial allowance. It creates no permission for a broader hard prison if a future implementation chooses to remove all Actions.

NEW the target may spend its ordinary Action examining the contradictions and make an INT/Investigation task check against the original spell DC. Success/Critical Success recognizes and leaves this mental state immediately; failure uses that Action and permits a fresh attempt on a later actual Action while the prison remains. This is an express repeatable escape action, not a generic unchanged-evidence skill retry. An actual source that specifically defeats the illusion retains its own success/removal permission; knowing that illusions exist alone is not a free removal. No external advice can forge a successful roll, though real evidence can support a separately applicable ordinary assistance rule.

NEW leaving is the first actual termination of the admitted mental state, including a successful escape, crossing its fixed boundary through independently legal involuntary displacement/teleport, normal expiry, replacement, voluntary dismissal or loss of concentration. That first departure deals one 5d10 psychic packet, then ends this application; a new real position outside the footprint never snaps back. Mark the exit entitlement spent before resolving the packet.
